claim_text: In a Channel 14 interview, Sara Netanyahu insinuated that Yair Golan's early response on October 7 indicated he had advance knowledge of the Hamas attack before the prime minister was informed.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 original interview/full context; N12 preservation; Times of Israel 2026-09-01; Netanyahu public clarification 2026-09-01
resolution_notes: Preserve the complete context: the interview contains the insinuation, but Sara Netanyahu also explicitly says she does not know what happened and does not adopt broader betrayal theories. Netanyahu's Sep. 1 response likewise said there was a grave failure rather than betrayal and said his wife had not said otherwise. These contextual statements materially narrow what can responsibly be fact-checked. Independent evidence still does not directly adjudicate the narrower Golan advance-knowledge implication, so no adverse verdict is forced. Origin remains Guest/interviewee, not Channel 14 editorial speech.
